description: Minimalist notes CLI in TypeScript. Serves as a didactic example of Harness Engineering.

features.name: project_architecture_analysis
features.title: project architecture analysis
features.description: Analyze the current project structure and output in the ARCHITECTURE.md file
acceptance: The ARCHITECTURE.md file should be updated or created
The file should include all the relevant details about project architecture
The file should provide useful information to consult when applying changes in the project

features.name: vue_migration
features.title: Vue Migration
features.description: Migrate the project to use Vue 3 and typescript with vite instead of react
acceptance: The project should be migrated to use Vue 3 and typescript with vite
All the existing integrations with the backend should work as they are currently working
The UI should look and feel the same as the current UI
All the local storage and context/state should be kept using vue tools and best practices
All the existing tests should pass
The project should be able to be built and run locally
The project should be able to be deployed to production

features.name: dev_execution_fix
features.title: Fix dev execution
features.description: Fix dev execution when running npm run dev
acceptance: The project should be able to run locally when running npm run dev
There shouldn't be errors in terminal when running npm run dev
There shouldn't be errors in browser when running npm run dev
There shouldn't be any typescript errors in the project
All the existing tests should pass
there should be test to check that the project builds correctly
The ARCHITECTURE.md file should be updated

features.name: remove_bcrypt_client
features.title: Remove bcrypt client
features.description: Remove bcrypt dependency and usage from the client side project
acceptance: The project should not use bcrypt
The project should not have any typescript errors
All the hash logic should be moved to /Documentos/euroncontest-api project to keep the logic working
All the endpoints that use hash logic should be updated
The backend should handle the hash logic
